title: machine_translate
description: The contract of the Function named by STAPEL_CMS['MACHINE_TRANSLATE'] (not provided by cms; stapel-translate's translate.text answers it). Input: a batch of plain texts (human text only: rich-text nodes one by one, never JSON) and the source/target locales. cms stays within MACHINE_TRANSLATE_MAX_TEXT_CHARS per text (longer texts are split at sentence boundaries), MACHINE_TRANSLATE_MAX_ITEMS texts and MACHINE_TRANSLATE_MAX_CHARS chars per call (defaults 5000 / 2000 / 200000 shown here), making several sequential calls with MACHINE_TRANSLATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS each. Output ($defs.result): {texts: [string]} of the same length and order. Any failure or other answer is refused: cms answers 503 with params.reason and creates nothing.

texts.description: At most 200000 chars in total per call (MACHINE_TRANSLATE_MAX_CHARS).
